task_limit: Controlled in-vitro goal-conditioned ideal-actuator simulation with perfect state. All object positions randomized on fixed MCA anatomy. Soft overlap costs, not hard collision physics. Diagnostic clearance feasibility is not collision-free policy performance or hardware verification.
